testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change appearance from an expanded panel title ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is at the top ✔ And the ribbon appearance is "Normal" ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned ✔ When the user right-clicks the lower Modify title ✔ And the user opens the "Ribbon Appearance" submenu ✔ Then "Normal" is checked and the Modify additional commands remain visible ✔ When the user selects "Text Off" ✔ Then the menus and Modify additional command area close ✔ And the ribbon displays command icons without their command labels ✔ And the panel titles remain visible ✔ When the user opens the Modify additional command area again ✔ And the user right-clicks the lower Modify title ✔ And the user opens the "Ribbon Appearance" submenu ✔ Then "Text Off" is checked ✔ When the user selects "Normal" ✔ Then the full ribbon displays its command labels again ✔ And the Modify additional command area remains closed
